mechanism: Nafcillin induces CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP3A4 and CYP2D6), reducing prochlorperazine metabolism and potentially increasing phenothiazine levels; additionally, both drugs can lower seizure threshold.
action: Monitor for increased prochlorperazine adverse effects (sedation, extrapyramidal symptoms, orthostasis) and consider dose adjustment; avoid concurrent use if possible or use alternative antibiotics with minimal enzyme induction.
